overall: The AG found the Holyoke City Council violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing a rezoning petition not listed on the August 4 notice, ordered compliance and a repeat discussion with ratification, and declined to review the public-participation claim.

allegations.summary: Council allegedly discussed at its August 4 meeting a rezoning petition topic that was not listed on the posted meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: We agree, and find that the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing an anticipated topic which was not included on the meeting notice.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council took up the topic off-notice to prevent him from speaking on it during public participation.
allegations.key_passage: As public participation is discretionary, this allegation would not constitute a violation of G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within 30 days of receipt of the determination, repeat the discussions regarding the specific petition, including ratifying any votes taken, during a properly posted future meeting.
remedy_passage: Additionally, we order the Council, within 30 days of receipt of this determination, to take steps to remedy the violation by repeating its discussions regarding the specific petition, including ratifying any votes taken, during a properly posted future meeting.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
